# Support

For reproducible bugs, open a Bug Report and include the commit/tag, Kaggle accelerator setting, relevant logs, and whether you used the default 512 profile.

For usage questions, first check `README.md`, `docs/kaggle-production-demo-notebook.md`, and `docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md`.

Do not post API tokens, GitHub PATs, private tunnel URLs, or other secrets in issues.
